deferred_questions: Does den want .dagger/ in its riskyPaths, so that a person merges each change to the merge rules? Asked in PR 1 and again in the PR 2 description.
plan.intent: Add two optional settings to the merge rules of .dagger/modules/ci. The empty value of each setting keeps the verdicts of den. (d) riskyExecutableBit: when it is true, the new rule executable-bit refuses a pull request that adds a file with git mode 100755, or that changes the mode of a file to 100755. The rules read the modes from the Git trees of the merge base and the head (GitHub REST git/trees, recursive). When GitHub cuts a tree (truncated), the rule refuses and gives the reason. (e) manifestFiles, manifestSafeFields and manifestSourcePrefix: for each changed file that a manifestFiles pattern matches (the riskyPaths semantics), the new rule manifest-fields compares the JSON object at the merge base and at the head. A top-level field outside manifestSafeFields that the pull request adds, removes or changes refuses. In a top-level list of entries, each entry is compared field by field, and source is safe only as a relative path under manifestSourcePrefix. A file that does not parse as a JSON object refuses. With no manifestFiles, the rule is off. The dagger.toml of den does not change, and the module code names no company, host, account or URL. Fixtures go in ci:automerge-rules, with mutation tests. INTERFACES.md (Dagger ci Module) describes the settings. Chorus task f4bbad07, AEC bead aec-16x.2, PR 2 of the order that MintRaven agreed.
